claim: A Data Lifecycle Manager default policy for EBS snapshots targets all volumes in the Region that do not have recent snapshots, with optional exclusions; a custom policy targets only volumes or instances that have specific tags.
question: Which volumes does a Data Lifecycle Manager default snapshot policy back up, compared with a custom policy?

values.display: Targets all volumes in the Region
values.spoken: targets all volumes in the Region

values.display: Targets only volumes or instances that have specific tags
values.spoken: targets only tagged volumes or instances

qualifiers.scope: per Data Lifecycle Manager snapshot policy
qualifiers.condition: default policy skips volumes with recent snapshots
